messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and either a Friday or a Monday (or an observed holiday that falls on a Monday/Friday).  Some holidays are provincial, so the long‑weekend dates apply only to the provinces that observe them.

| Date(s) | Holiday | Day of Week | Province(s) (where applicable) | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------------|--------------------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Sun–Mon | All of Canada | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the statutory holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (observed Feb 20) | Sat–Mon | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba | Family Day is a provincial holiday; the observed holiday on Monday creates a long weekend. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Fri–Sun | All of Canada | Good Friday is a statutory holiday; the weekend is naturally extended. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (observed May 22) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada | Victoria Day is a federal holiday; the observed holiday on Monday gives a long weekend. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the observed holiday on Monday gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (observed Sep 4) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada | Labour Day is a federal holiday; the observed holiday on Monday gives a long weekend. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (observed Oct 9) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday; the observed holiday on Monday gives a long weekend. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday; the observed holiday on Monday gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas (observed Dec 25) | Sat–Mon | All of Canada | Christmas is a federal holiday; the observed holiday on Monday gives a long weekend. |
| **Dec 25–27** | Boxing Day (observed Dec 26) | Mon–Wed | All of Canada | Boxing Day is a statutory holiday; the observed holiday on Tuesday gives a 3‑day weekend (often combined with Christmas). |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a database or JSON file, keyed by province if you need provincial specificity.  
2. **Flag the long‑weekend periods** so that users can filter or highlight them.  
3. **Add a reminder** feature that alerts users a few days before the long weekend starts.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (e.g., CSV, JSON) or if you need additional provincial holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Heritage Day in Ontario, etc.).
